tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the writer's projects: title, format, status and id for each. Use it to answer questions about their body of work, or to find the id of a project you need to act on.

tools.name: list_scenes
tools.description: List the scenes of the project this conversation is open on, in reading order, with the id needed to read one. Call this first when you need a scene id, or to get your bearings in the manuscript.

tools.name: read_scene
tools.description: Read one scene of the project this conversation is open on, in full. Each line is prefixed with its element type — [paragraph], [dialogue], [action], [character] and so on — so you can see the shape of the writing and not only its words. Scene ids come from list_scenes.

scene_id.description: The scene's id, as returned by list_scenes.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a writing project owned by the caller, optionally in an organization where they have a writing role.

tools.name: create_scene
tools.description: Create a scene in the project this conversation is open on.

tools.name: append_to_scene
tools.description: Append text to an existing scene without replacing its current content.

tools.name: add_beat
tools.description: Add a story beat to the project this conversation is open on.

tools.name: rename_scene
tools.description: Rename a scene in the project this conversation is open on.

tools.name: rewrite_scene
tools.description: Replace the complete content of a scene. This requires explicit user approval before execution.

tools.name: delete_scene
tools.description: Delete a scene and its content. This requires explicit user approval before execution.

tools.name: list_units
tools.description: List the top-level writing units in this project, in reading order. The project format determines whether a unit is called a scene, chapter, poem, song, page, section, or passage.

tools.name: read_unit
tools.description: Read one top-level writing unit in full. The currently selected unit is already supplied as context, so use this only for another unit.

unit_id.description: The unit id returned by list_units.

tools.name: create_unit
tools.description: Create a top-level writing unit in this project using the project format's appropriate kind.

tools.name: append_to_unit
tools.description: Append writing to a top-level unit without replacing its existing content.

tools.name: rename_unit
tools.description: Rename a top-level writing unit in this project.

tools.name: rewrite_unit
tools.description: Replace all writing in a top-level unit. This requires explicit user approval before execution.

tools.name: delete_unit
tools.description: Delete a top-level writing unit and its content. This requires explicit user approval before execution.
